deliverables: scripts/run_A1.py (Python-driven EA: tournament + 1pt crossover + mutation, validity-gated resample, train/test split)

root_cause: Grammar ops are axis-index-based (AX/SCALE/NORM/MIX/ROT/FRAC on raw coordinates). Embedding T_i lives mostly in top-SV directions, not in first 16 coordinates. G seeds its 16-dim state with T_i[0..16] (truncation) -- loses 20% of energy before grammar even starts. D reconstructs by index-based ops -- cannot synthesize top-SV direction mix. Ceiling F=0.17 corresponds roughly to sqrt(||T_i[:16]||^2) averaged = sqrt(spectral_energy_first_16_axes). EA finds this ceiling on gen 0 and cannot escape it (validity rate of mutation/crossover appears fine -- evaluated 50*30=1500 individuals same as random diag; F_max identical). Conclusion: A1 as-specified cannot pass G3 (F > 0.7132) because the grammar's algebraic closure over index-based ops does not span the embedding manifold.

implications.G4: may still pass -- silhouette_cos=0.43 suggests good clustering of codes
implications.G6: trivially passes -- best is len=4 vs threshold 12
